description: Verify that DUT opens 3 active sockets and completes the 3-way handshake on each (RFC 793 §3.4)
approach:
[Objective]
Multiple concurrent active OPENs. Each must produce its own SYN, receive SYN,ACK, and emit the third-leg ACK.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester (UT) → DUT: 3 active OPEN calls.
2. DUT → Tester: SYN per leg.
3. Tester → DUT: SYN,ACK per leg.
4. DUT → Tester: ACK per leg (handshake complete).

[Pass condition]
All 3 third-leg ACKs observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_leg<n> — no DUT handshake ACK for the corresponding leg

verdicts.Pass: DUT completed 3 concurrent active opens — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout_leg1: No DUT handshake ACK for leg 1
verdicts.Fail_timeout_leg2: No DUT handshake ACK for leg 2
verdicts.Fail_timeout_leg3: No DUT handshake ACK for leg 3
